# perf-verifier

One Agent Skill plus a Python 3 script. No third-party package. The script does not import a network library.

Repo: https://github.com/David-Florian2013/perf-verifier

Install:

npx skills add David-Florian2013/perf-verifier -g -a '*' -y

Do not call code faster without a measurement. scan flags patterns such as a list copied inside a loop. bench, profile, scale and compare print times. FASTER is the only compare result that supports the word "faster".

The demo runs scan on examples/slow.py and examples/fast.py. slow.py copies the list on every iteration. fast.py appends. The scan output is the locked transcript. Timings are not, because they change per machine.

MIT.
